title: The second sealed journeys set's misses fixed on dev, a third frozen first
request: After the second sealed set failed at 24 of 30, fix its misses without tuning on the people that will judge the fixes.
spec: A third sealed set by an independent agent, frozen before any change; the second set's misses fixed as dev material; the third run once.
plan: Freeze the third set and commit it with the second run's result.
Fix each with a test, including the product's dead end.
Commit, gate, run the third set once.

decisions.decision: A prediction moment of eight characters is enough for the Solution page.
decisions.why: Home accepted 'at renewal' and the page refused it: a dead end for a person who answered.

decisions.decision: A count said for next month beside a yes or no column is asked, never read as a forecast.
decisions.why: How many customers will churn next month is a churn problem with that column.

decisions.decision: A forecast whose moment came from the problem sentence keeps its covariates out until someone says they are known ahead.
decisions.why: Keeping a column out costs accuracy; reading one in that is not known costs the result.

change: dclab_core/card.py; dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py; dclab_rnd/kinds/forecasting.py; dclab_rnd/studio/solution.py; journeys (the third set, its gate); tests problem_card, journeys, core_forecast.

findings.defect: Two people's short moments were refused after Home accepted them.
findings.scenario: 'At renewal' and 'at listing' stopped the journey at the Solution page.
findings.cause: The page asked for twelve characters, Home for none.

findings.defect: Three families said in words the rules did not read.
findings.scenario: How much each shop needs the coming week; how many months we keep them with members still active; many would have bought anyway.
findings.fix: Each phrasing read, tied to its context.

findings.defect: An outcome named after a word was lost.
findings.scenario: 'duration days_subscribed' left the card without its outcome.
findings.cause: Only an answer that began with the column was read as naming it.
findings.fix: Up to two words such as duration or target may come before it.

findings.defect: A verb's other form was not read as known ahead.
findings.scenario: 'Marketing sets them weeks before' left the promotion unknown.

findings.defect: A count for next month beside a yes or no column was read as forecasting.
findings.scenario: How many customers will churn next month became a forecast.
findings.cause: Forecasting was never asked against a column.
findings.fix: Asked beside a yes or no column.

findings.defect: The disk filled while journeys ran in parallel.
findings.scenario: Free space fell to under two gigabytes with swap near full.
findings.cause: Several engines at once on a full disk.

measurements.name: dev material
measurements.gate: every dev journey and every card on the earlier sealed sets right
measurements.result: dev 15 of 15; the first sealed set's cards 30 of 30; the second set 29 of 30, its miss a forecast whose moment came from the problem sentence
measurements.against_gate: every dev journey right and every card right
limits: Dev material: the fixes were made on these people.

outcome: The second set's misses are fixed on dev but one; the third sealed set judges them.
lessons: A page that refuses what an earlier page accepted is a dead end: the two must share one rule.
Freeze the next sealed set before reading the last one's misses as dev material.
risks: A forecast's known-ahead columns stay unknown when the moment came from the problem sentence.
